title: On a General Principle Useful in the Explanation of the Laws of Nature
summary: The order-continuity principle at work: nature makes no leaps, and the laws of motion follow from the general principle of order.
sourceNote: Seed text: G. M. Duncan, The Philosophical Works of Leibnitz (New Haven, 1908), translated from the French; OCR transcription from the archive.org scan (worksofleibniz00leibuoft), US public domain.
